Iam._comment: Enforced=false runs the permission filter in SHADOW mode: it logs 'IAM SHADOW would block ...' and lets requests through. Set true only after applying migration 202 and reviewing those logs. DenyUnmapped controls whether a route missing from IamPermissionMap is blocked; leave false so adding a controller cannot take the API down.
Iam._comment3: EnforceWrites=true refuses create/edit/delete/approve/reverse a staff member has not been given, while reads stay in shadow. This is what makes 'view only' and 'enter but not approve' bite. Owners are never restricted.
Iam._comment2: Page access upgrade (migrations 506/507): after the shadow run is clean, set Enforced, DenyUnmapped and RequireAuthentication to true together. Enforced also makes dashboards hide money figures from staff without <module>.dashboard-financials.view.
